THE BRIEF

"totals mixed with unitary prices · narrative tooltips with a bunch of info that should just be represented at a glance · metrics are just bombarded · I wanna understand, above everything else, the numbers involved in the decisionmaking and the reason it got categorized as x or y or z · ultimately I wanna be able to understand the process so I can catch possible bugs or mistakes when using it"

Static mockups, real arithmetic. Every figure below reconciles — substitute and check.

READING ORDER

1 Row, redesigned — what the table looks like
2 Expanded ledger — the audit trail for one row
3 Tooltips → widgets — the four you screenshotted
4 House rules — the rules that make it stay clean
5 Alternates — two other ways to shape the row

Nothing in index.html has changed. Pick a direction first.
